notes.title: Update 0.16.11
notes.content:
Balancing

 Trait Communist:
  -Min threshold is now based on player count: Min threshold = player count/2

Changes

 Added game version validation when joining a lobby
 Player disconnects can now show the disconnect reason in chat

Fixes

 Join and disconnect chat messages are now localized
 Fixed a navigation bug in the main menu UI
 Localized kick and ban messages.

notes.title: Update 0.16.10
notes.content:
Changes
 Barricade:
  -Has been put in a new placeable category so that other placeables like a Bear Trap do not prevent the placement of the Barricade.

 Added playtest-specific info boxes.
Fixes
 Fixed Communist gold mine expropriation message not coloring the previous owner of the gold mine correctly.

 Fixed Magnets still working to some extend after the unit lost the effect.

 Fixed Barricades blocking units from moving forward when standing on the field that the Barricade is placed behind.

 The knife and grenade now move with the unit in all animations.
